name: building-backends
title_zh: 改 NestJS 接口时先替你查 Prisma 关联
tagline_zh: 写 Controller、Service、DTO、守卫、分页、异常处理前，先扫一遍 schema 和查询。
tagline_en: Before you touch controllers, services, DTOs, guards, pagination, or errors, it scans your Prisma schema and.
desc_en: Use when building or changing any backend API — NestJS controllers, services, modules, DTOs, Prisma schema or queries, auth guards, pagination, or error handling — and when scaffolding a new backend or adding an endpoint.
why_zh: 它把「后端改动」当成一次跨层一致性检查：不只生成代码，还会顺着依赖链核对 auth 守卫。
why_en: It treats every backend change as a cross-layer consistency check: not just generating code, but tracing auth guards.
limit_zh: 只认 NestJS + Prisma 技术栈；不碰 Express 裸路由、TypeORM 或 MongoDB。
limit_en: NestJS + Prisma only; no Express, TypeORM, or MongoDB. Scaffolds file skeletons only — no migrations, deploys, or test cases. Won't touch.
title_en: Backend API builder that checks Prisma relations before.
